title: Spices Board Recruitment 2026 – Trainee (Development) Posts
shortInfo: Spices Board has announced notification for Trainee (Development) posts. Required qualification: B.Sc in Agri/Horti/Forestry/Bot/Micro/Biotech. Last date to apply: 19-10-26.
howToApply: Before appearing for the written test, candidates must ensure that the application is submitted online. Last date for submitting online application is 19.10.2026.
Eligible candidates shall submit the application online at http://spicesboard.in/recruitment/.
Candidates reporting after the specified time or failing to submit their application online will not be permitted to participate in the test.
Candidates are required to report at the venue at least 30 minutes prior to the scheduled time for certificate verification.
Candidates must bring all original documents and certificates, along with one set of self-attested copies each, pertaining to identity, age, and educational qualifications for verification purpose.
Those who have not received their final degree certificate yet need not appear for the test.
Before applying, candidates should ensure that they fulfill the eligibility criteria for the training as mentioned in the notification.
Those who have undergone training in any offices of Spices Board earlier need not apply again regardless of whether they have completed their training or not.
Candidates once selected will be required to undergo training in any of the offices of Spices Board under the mentioned region/regional office.
No TA/DA will be given to candidates who attend the Written Test.
Candidates are advised to check the Board’s website www.indianspices.com for updates and not to rely on information from third-party websites.
Candidates shall obtain the original Degree certificate within two years from the date of issue of Provisional Degree certificate.

title: Arunachal Pradesh PSC Recruitment 2026 – Group-A, Group-B Posts
shortInfo: Arunachal Pradesh PSC has announced notification for Group-A, Group-B posts. Required qualification: Technical qualifications as per exam. Last date to apply: 12-10-26.

dates.event: Last Date for Submission of Online Application

howToApply: Before filling the Online Application Form, a candidate must mandatorily register for ONE TIME REGISTRATION (OTR) on the APPSC website https://appsc.gov.in.
Those who have already registered in OTR need not register again; they can directly login using their user ID and password.
Candidates are required to apply online on APPSC website https://appsc.gov.in.
The online application submission link shall be active from 1700 hours on 21.09.2026 till 1700 hours on 12.10.2026.
Applicants are advised to submit only a single application. If multiple applications are submitted, only the application with the highest Registration ID (RID) will be accepted.
Candidates should carefully fill the requisite details in the application form. No additional time shall be provided for any further change or uploading of additional information after submission.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 200/- through online mode only (PwD candidates are exempted).

Upload all required scanned documents including signature, passport size photo, photo ID, APST certificate, PRC, degree certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates (if applicable), and disability certificate (if applicable).

howToApply: Before filling the Online Application Form, a candidate must mandatorily register for ONE TIME REGISTRATION (OTR) on https://appsc.gov.in.
Those who have already registered in OTR need not register again; they can directly login using the same user ID and password.
Candidates are required to apply online on https://appsc.gov.in. Detailed instructions for OTR and Online Application are available on the APPSC website.

Submit only a single application. If multiple applications are submitted, the application with the highest Registration ID (RID) will be accepted. The fee paid against one RID shall not be adjusted against any other RID.
The online application submission link shall be active from 1700 hours on 16th September, 2026 till 1700 hours on 20th October, 2026.
Carefully fill all requisite details in the online application form. The application once submitted cannot be changed or updated.
Upload scanned copies of required documents: Signature, passport size photo, Matriculation Certificate, APST Certificate, PRC, and other relevant documents as applicable.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 200/- through online mode (PwD candidates are exempted).
